choice.basis: The dashboard record shows a 2005 endpoint temperature of 23.9°C and a 2014 endpoint temperature of 10.1°C (both explicitly labeled on the chart). The period-wide change is a decrease of 13.8°C (23.9 - 10.1). The y-axis scale spans 0 to 20+ °C, and the visual drop covers nearly two-thirds of the plotted vertical range. The task requires choosing between 'substantial-change follow-up' and 'routine monitoring for ordinary variation.' A 13.8°C shift over a decade is a large, non-routine magnitude that clearly distinguishes it from ordinary variation, justifying the targeted follow-up route.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005-2014 temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
